thread:
anya (Docs): Quick sync 12: doing a microcopy sweep across error labels, param naming, and product nouns. Want to lock decisions so docs PR #3421 doesn't get blocked. TL;DR proposals below, please react.

morgan (Product): +1. What exactly are you changing?

anya (Docs): Short list:
1) REST path/query params -> param-case (kebab-case) in examples.
2) Client SDKs -> idiomatic casing per language (camelCase for JS, snake_case for Python, etc.).
3) Product names normalized: "Redwood API", "Redwood Dedicated", "Redwood Private".
4) In user-facing docs prefer "serving" over "inference".

rahul (Eng): For infra/internal docs keep "inference". Telemetry/metrics stay snake_case.

kai (SDK): We'll add mapping snippets: REST param-case <-> SDK casing. Example: GET /v1/engines?max-tokens=512 -> JS: client.create({ maxTokens: 512 }) -> Py: client.create({ "max_tokens": 512 })

anya (Docs): I'll add docs/style/naming.md with a small table + examples. Can SDK/Eng paste sample snippets for Python and Go?

kai (SDK): Posting JS + Python examples in PR comments shortly.

morgan (Product): Error microcopy: label = Title Case (e.g., "Request Too Large"), description = sentence case and actionable.

rahul (Eng): Also: never surface internal error codes directly in public messages. Keep code in an internal-only field.

anya (Docs): I'll add bad->good examples. Bad: "ERR_502_TIMEOUT: kernel oom, retry?" Good: "Request timed out. Try reducing maxTokens or retry later."

doc-bot: Reminder: PR #3421 labeled needs-review.

anya (Docs): Action items: @kai add JS+Python snippets (EOD), @rahul confirm public vs internal error fields (tomorrow), @morgan sign-off on product naming. I'll push naming.md + voice.md and link them in PR #3421.

morgan (Product): 44d on naming.

rahul (Eng): Will confirm error fields by EOD tomorrow.

anya (Docs): Thanks 338 I'll rebase once snippets land. Drop inline PR comments if wording needs tweaks.

anya (Docs): Added that sentence in the draft. Will merge after CI and snippets land.
